name: Ashok Ram
tagline: I build new features, take on open tasks and fix bugs in open-source developer tools and AI infrastructure, every change shipped with tests.

github_achievements.name: Pull Shark
github_achievements.note: two or more merged pull requests

contributions.what: Cmd-click with the Selection tool selects the object behind; each further click goes one deeper and wraps back to the front
a shape's Rectangle and Ellipse Size get the Constrain Proportions chain, off by default
the Reuse Slides picker shows a thumbnail of each slide beside its title
JPEG Options shows how big the file will be, updating as quality and format change
A movie whose file is gone kept its raw stored path and was never marked offline, so the Video track opened it relative to the working directory
A refused MIDI file (track longer than a day) left tracks and a new tempo map behind with no undo; the import now checks the whole file before the session changes
a spine line where the pages of a spread meet, screen-only, hidden with the other guides and in preview modes
Table Gauge cells: bar widths didn't match the values because an inverted comparison let the first-rendered row set the column's text reservation

tauri dev stopped watching the whole app when .taurignore contained /*. Watch folders are now always walked and ignore rules filter their entries and change events, with unit tests and an end-to-end check
Crash-safety: a panic in a command's pre-checks or bookkeeping crashed the app; now caught and reported as an error, with a regression test
Root-caused "Offset Path resets 0.1 mm to 1 mm": decimal-comma input is rejected and the field silently keeps its old value. Proposed three fixes for the maintainers to choose from

noUselessEmptyExport deleted a meaningful export {} from .d.ts files, leaking private types into the public API. The rule now skips declaration files, matching typescript-eslint; fixtures and changeset included
Out-of-bounds read in n-gram speculative drafting when the input is shorter than the n-gram size. Bounds check plus a sanitizer-verified regression test
A small EMF/WMF file could hold many maximum-size embedded images and tie up the app for minutes. Each file now gets one decoded-pixel budget, charged before decoding, with a regression test
SVG import now reads rounded rectangle corners (rx/ry) as the SVG spec defines them. Circular corners become true CAD arcs and elliptical ones are traced, from CADCraft's own gap list

PRAGMA data_version, the cheap SQLite way to poll for changes. It moves when another connection or process commits and never for the connection's own commits, matching SQLite case by case, with a cross-process test

the Render Queue now writes Targa (.tga) image sequences: 24-bit RGB, or 32-bit with straight or premultiplied alpha, with every frame checked byte for byte against the PNG output and read back through EffectCraft's own importer
saved views completed: all 25 views are now listed in the View menu (only 10 were), Edit Views opens a proper rename/delete list as one undo step, and views from a file are checked when it opens

Parser fix: a regex like (/<!-- x -->/) in a module was wrongly read as an HTML comment (and crashed the formatter in scripts). The arrow-function lookahead now stops early, as TypeScript's does, with unit and conformance tests
After saving a CSV, Save in the close dialog asked again forever. It now closes once the file is written, and keeps multi-sheet workbooks open with a clear message so no sheet is lost silently
Security: the macOS install check could follow a planted symlink and empty another file. It now probes with a randomly named, create-only file, with a symlink regression test

Mastra plugin: Mastra's CLI finds agents, tools and workflows by folder convention under src/mastra/, so Knip reported them as unused. The plugin adds those conventions from Mastra's own source, with fixtures

Islands never hydrated on a page whose main thread never goes idle: island_script.js waited on requestIdleCallback with no timeout. It now gets the same 2 s backstop the hydration script has, with a test
A comment just inside the ( of a label's body moved on every format run. It is now attached to the label, where the second run already put it, with an idempotency test
first(s, typemax(Int)) returned an empty string for non-ASCII text: nextind overflowed to a negative index. It now saturates, which also fixes Iterators.partition on strings
average pooling gets dilation, threaded the same way as max pooling through every layer and the gradient, so the ONNX importer can lower dilated AveragePool
Tailwind @import "./x.css" failed with disableInlineImports: the CSS goes to the CLI on stdin, so relative paths resolved against the project root. They now resolve against the source file
quarkus:dev generated code before application.properties was copied, so gRPC settings like scan-for-proto were ignored. Dev mode now runs same-phase goals in Maven's priority order

Compressing sinks (Loki, HTTP, S3 and others) reported compressed bytes in component_sent_bytes_total; Vector's spec says before compression. The shared request builder now passes the uncompressed size it already had
